title: C2D command (inbound)
description: DESCRIPTIVE, NOT NORMATIVE. Generated from firmware source at FW 1.8.0 and re-verified field by field against FW 2.1.4 (branch fix/2.1.4, release commit "chore(release): 2.1.4", whose parent is x-nearest-commit). x-source line numbers are from the 1.8.0 generation and are STALE; fields added or changed for 2.1.4 cite functions instead. This is not a specification and not a proposal; it records what the device emits today. Plane: C2D commands (INBOUND — not telemetry). `required` lists only keys present in the minimal payload, i.e. those always emitted for this message type.

schema.description: Envelope identifier. Canonical "eflostop.cmd"; the legacy form is "eflostop.cmd.v1". A legacy plain-text form carries no envelope at all.

id.description: Optional correlation id, echoed back as data.id on the resulting cmd_ack. If absent, cmd_ack omits data.id entirely.

cmd.description: Which command to run. One of the eleven names in section 14.

payload.description: Command-specific arguments. The shape depends entirely on cmd, so this schema does not constrain it - see section 14 for each command's keys.
